title: On solutions to tropical Monge-Ampère equations
summary: This paper develops convex analysis on tropical varieties and investigates the properties of the tropical Monge-Ampère equations. We start by introducing notions of plurisubharmonic functions and Kähler forms on arbitrary tropical varieties. We show that many classical results of pluripotential theory extend to this setting, including an analogue of Demailly's regularization theorem. Next, we study the solutions to the tropical Monge-Ampère equations. While we establish their uniqueness, we show that the existence is not guaranteed in general.
